title: Use Pippit + Seedance 2.0 Mini by chatting with the AI Agent and entering only…
content:
Use Pippit + Seedance 2.0 Mini by chatting with the AI Agent and entering only your product details plus a simple keyword (no long script) to generate a creator-style commerce video.  
In Pippit, go to the Marketing Video tab and choose the Creator-Style Commerce Videos format for e-commerce UGC-style ads.  
When prompting, include product highlights plus sensory cues (taste, texture, reactions) and/or offers so the agent builds a more convincing creator-style script.  
Generate multiple creator-style variations quickly to test different hooks, emotions, and product angles instead of producing one polished ad.
